scripts.docker:build:prod: docker build --target production -t techtrend-app:prod . && npm run docker:prune
scripts.test:db:migrate: dotenv run -q -- sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres_test_password}@localhost:5434/techtrend_test}" npx prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.docker:build:ci: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml build node-ci && npm run docker:prune
scripts.docker:build:e2e: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml build playwright-e2e && npm run docker:prune
scripts.docker:prune: docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -f --max-used-space 20GB
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e NODE_ENV=production node-ci npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build --webpack
scripts.docker:lint:ci: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm node-ci npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:node:serial && npm run test:dom
scripts.docker:test:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test redis-test
scripts.docker:test:run: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm node-ci sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npm test'
scripts.docker:test:file: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e TEST_FILE -e TEST_NAME_PATTERN -e JEST_SERIAL_DB node-ci sh -c 'if [ -z "$TEST_FILE" ]; then echo "Usage: TEST_FILE=\"<path>\" [TEST_NAME_PATTERN=\"<pattern>\"] npm run docker:test:file" >&2; exit 2; fi; npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npx jest -c jest.config.node.js "$TEST_FILE" ${TEST_NAME_PATTERN:+--testNamePattern="$TEST_NAME_PATTERN"}'
scripts.docker:test:file:update-snapshot: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e TEST_FILE -e CI=false -v $(pwd)/__tests__:/app/__tests__ node-ci sh -c 'if [ -z "$TEST_FILE" ]; then echo "Usage: TEST_FILE=\"<path>\" npm run docker:test:file:update-snapshot" >&2; exit 2; fi; npx jest -c jest.config.node.js "$TEST_FILE" -u'
scripts.docker:test:react:file: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e TEST_FILE -e TEST_NAME_PATTERN node-ci sh -c 'if [ -z "$TEST_FILE" ]; then echo "Usage: TEST_FILE=\"<path>\" [TEST_NAME_PATTERN=\"<pattern>\"] npm run docker:test:react:file" >&2; exit 2; fi; npx jest -c jest.config.dom.js "$TEST_FILE" ${TEST_NAME_PATTERN:+--testNamePattern="$TEST_NAME_PATTERN"}'
scripts.docker:test: npm run docker:test:up && npm run docker:test:run
scripts.docker:test:spec: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -z "${TEST_FILE:-}" ]; then echo "Usage: TEST_FILE=\"<path-to-test>\" npm run docker:test:spec" >&2; exit 2; fi; npm run docker:test:up && npm run docker:test:file'
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test redis-test && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres_test_password}@localhost:5434/techtrend_test npm run test:integration; TEST_EXIT=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down; exit $TEST_EXIT
scripts.migrate:production:check: bash scripts/db/with-prod-db.sh --as-database-url npx prisma migrate status
scripts.calibrate:promote: cp lib/ai/testing/golden-set-calibrated.json lib/ai/testing/golden-set.json && echo 'Promoted calibrated thresholds to golden-set.json'
scripts.test:db:setup: dotenv run -q -- sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL_HOST" npx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL_HOST" npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts'
scripts.test:db:reset:prisma: dotenv run -q -- sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL_HOST" npx prisma migrate reset --force'
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run test:db:up && npm run test:db:setup && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docker:e2e:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test redis-test
scripts.docker:e2e:run: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm playwright-e2e sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npx playwright test --reporter=list'
scripts.docker:e2e:run:fast: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm playwright-e2e sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npx playwright test --project=chromium --reporter=list'
scripts.docker:e2e:file: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e E2E_FILE playwright-e2e sh -c 'if [ -z "$E2E_FILE" ]; then echo "Usage: E2E_FILE=\"<spec>\" npm run docker:e2e:file" >&2; exit 2; fi; npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npx playwright test --reporter=list "$E2E_FILE"'
scripts.docker:e2e:file:fast: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e E2E_FILE playwright-e2e sh -c 'if [ -z "$E2E_FILE" ]; then echo "Usage: E2E_FILE=\"<spec>\" npm run docker:e2e:file:fast" >&2; exit 2; fi; npx prisma migrate deploy && npx tsx prisma/seed-test.ts && npx playwright test --project=chromium --reporter=list "$E2E_FILE"'
scripts.docker:e2e: npm run docker:e2e:up && npm run docker:e2e:run
scripts.docker:e2e:fast: npm run docker:e2e:up && npm run docker:e2e:run:fast
scripts.docker:e2e:rebuild: npm run docker:build:e2e && npm run docker:e2e
scripts.docker:e2e:rebuild:fast: npm run docker:build:e2e && npm run docker:e2e:fast
scripts.docker:e2e:spec: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -z "${E2E_FILE:-}" ]; then echo "Usage: E2E_FILE=\"<spec>\" npm run docker:e2e:spec" >&2; exit 2; fi; npm run docker:e2e:up && npm run docker:e2e:file'
scripts.collect:local: LOG_LEVEL=warn DEBUG= dotenv run -q -- tsx scripts/scheduled/collect-feeds.ts
scripts.summarize:local: LOG_LEVEL=warn DEBUG= dotenv run -q -- tsx scripts/maintenance/generate-summaries.ts
